subtitle: 556 seats · Over-the-Rhine
_sources: Memorial Hall Production Specifications (Dropbox/3CDC Memorial Hall/Production Assets, 'Updated March 2025'; same text in ~/Downloads/...docx 2026-09-29). The spec still lists a Yamaha CL3; CLAUDE.md and the Q225 template work say the house desk is now a DiGiCo Quantum 225, so the console lines are confirm until Brian settles them.
intro: What Memorial Hall provides, and what we need from you. Virtual tour: memorialhallotr.com/virtual-tour

items.label: Shape
items.text: Trapezoidal. 22'5" deep at center; back wall 22'5" wide, 37'4" at the widest point.

items.label: Height
items.text: 11'5" at the back wall ledge, 18' at center stage, 23' downstage center.

items.label: Shell
items.text: Permanent orchestra shell: upstage wall 12' high, scalloping to 20'+ at the plaster line.

items.label: Access
items.text: Stage-left and stage-right doorways, 2'7" W × 6'10" H. 5'11" piano door on the USR wall.

items.label: Rigging
items.text: No soft goods and no overstage rigging for backdrops, soft goods or lighting.

items.label: House
items.text: 556 seats, 11 accessible. Historic building, opened 1908.

items.label: PA
items.text: Sound Bridge line array per side: 6× Xyon 7108XY, 1× Xyon 6118XY 18" sub. Front fills: 4× 3208HTH.

items.label: House console
items.text: DiGiCo Quantum 225 (spec sheet still lists Yamaha CL3 with Dante and a Rio 3224)

items.label: FOH position
items.text: House right balcony, full view of the stage, no booth or overhang.

items.label: Tour console
items.text: Rear center of the orchestra (Box M). No drylines there; PA drivelines are stage left. Tour feeds L/R/front fill/sub to the house console and provides the ~150' run to the stage box.

items.label: Monitors
items.text: 8× Sound Bridge 7122W 12" wedges and 4× Sennheiser EW300 in-ear systems, mixed from FOH. No house monitor console; a console and split are a rental if needed. Monitor position is offstage left.

items.label: Sound limit
items.text: 95 dB LAeq (A-weighted), measured at balcony center, per local ordinance.

items.label: Piano
items.text: Yamaha C3 PE grand (6'1") with Helpinstill pickups.

items.label: Backline
items.text: None. The venue carries no backline instruments or amps.

items.label: Stands
items.text: Tall, medium and short tripod booms, round-base booms and straights, tabletop stands, 11 guitar stands, 25 music stands, conductor's stand.

items.label: Seating
items.text: 20 Wenger orchestra chairs, 6 backless barstools.

items.label: Risers
items.text: 4× 4'×8'×12" Wenger risers with black skirting, 6 Wenger 3-level choral risers, conductor's podium.

items.label: Other
items.text: Drum rugs, pipe and drape for the back wall, two podiums with gooseneck mics, 25 clip lights (may incur a fee).

items.label: Console
items.text: ETC Ion Element 40, upper rear balcony center. House light control always stays with the house console and crew.

items.label: Rig
items.text: 14 ETC Source 4 (14° and 19°), 10 ETC Lustre LED zoom, 2 Robin DLX movers, 6 LED wash-zoom movers, 14 LED overhead track wash, 8 LED uplights, 4 Elation Fuze 120, 4 stand-alone truss towers with LED pars.

items.label: Extras
items.text: Water-based hazer and 2 spotlights, both at additional cost.

items.label: Tour lighting
items.text: A tour console sits in the house left balcony; a ground package needs its own 150' of cable.

items.label: Video
items.text: Panasonic PT-RZ970BU laser projector (10,000 lm, WUXGA) onto a motorized 135" × 240" 16:9 screen, about 9' upstage of the lip. HDMI input from backstage. The screen can't be rehung.

items.label: Load-in
items.text: Street level through a 2'7" × 6'10" doorway into a freight elevator (5' W × 7'8" L × 7' H). No loading dock; flat push. The stage is on the 2nd floor.

items.label: Parking
items.text: Details come with your advance.

items.label: Power
items.text: One 400A 3-phase disconnect backstage stage right. No shore power; generators are OK.

items.label: Stage level
items.text: Rooms A (SR) and B (SL): 2–3 people each, vanity mirror and counter, private toilet.

items.label: Balcony level
items.text: Rooms C (SR) and D (SL): 5 people each, mirrors, tables, chairs, couches, no private toilet.

items.label: Studio
items.text: Large basement multipurpose room with mirrors, tables and chairs; restroom shared with staff.

items.label: Note
items.text: All rooms lock and are climate-controlled. No showers, towels or laundry onsite.

sections.title: Terms
items: Load-out starts immediately after the performance, and the building must be clear within two hours of the end of the show.
Anything left behind may be disposed of; contact staff right away if you've left something.
